channel.title: Chandra Ramanujan — Essays
channel.description: Essays on design, product, and technology by Chandra Ramanujan.

item.title: Why we banned "fortnite" but not "fortnight"
item.description: Why a district content-moderation tool matches keywords by exact string instead of meaning, and why the smarter-looking option was the wrong one.

item.title: The ratings we didn't show
item.description: An experiment found that restaurant ratings only lifted click-through when the rating was good. Why the click-optimal move — hiding bad ratings — was the wrong one.

item.title: Why the moderation toggle is deliberately annoying
item.description: Removing friction is the usual job. Here's why I put friction back into a district-wide content-blocking toggle and defended it in review.

item.title: Copy-paste beats CSV
item.description: CSV upload was the obvious input method for a keyword block list. Why we cut it and made admins paste or type by hand instead.

item.title: Very smooth, very powerful
item.description: An ad-agency internship, a test drive I couldn't legally conduct, and how I figured out I was in the wrong room.
